title: Data generation for the DS2OS traffic traces using GAN
summary: A set of Jupyter notebooks that generate synthetic minority-class network traffic records (DS2OS and NSL-KDD intrusion-detection datasets) to address class imbalance for training intrusion-detection classifiers, using SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with Metadata and conditional sampling to fit and sample synthetic tabular data.
